name: apply
description: Apply any unapplied D1 migrations. Creates the bookkeeping table if absent, diffs the migration files under --dir against what the table records, and applies the rest in numeric order. Wire-compatible with `wrangler d1 migrations apply`: same table shape, same --dir-relative recorded names, same ordering. The database must be identified by ID; names and binding names are not accepted.

options.name: pattern
options.description: Glob for discovering migration files. Defaults to "<dir>/*.sql"; Drizzle's nested layout uses "<dir>/*/migration.sql"

options.name: table
options.description: Table recording applied migrations; must use Wrangler's bookkeeping schema (default: d1_migrations)

name: create
description: Create a new empty D1 migration file, numbered one above the highest existing migration. Entirely local — takes no database, needs no credentials and makes no network calls. If an ORM manages your migrations, use its own generator instead; for Drizzle, use `drizzle-kit generate`.

options.name: pattern
options.description: Glob the new file must match, so `apply` will pick it up

name: list
description: List unapplied D1 migrations as JSON. Applies nothing.

options.name: pattern
options.description: Glob for discovering migration files. Defaults to "<dir>/*.sql"

options.name: table
options.description: Table recording applied migrations; must use Wrangler's bookkeeping schema (default: d1_migrations)
